verdict.rationale: AIMA is a government immigration agency, so a published paper, fax, or mail fallback for online filing is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has only a failed TLS probe of aima.gov.pt/robots.txt; nothing was fetched about offline submission addresses, fax numbers, or paper forms. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable
